fields.Trigger: New imported SKU or classification review

workflows.name: HS Tariff Classification & AHTN Code Assignment per Imported SKU

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-document of "assigns AHTN/HS code per SKU based on material, function, composition" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-validate of "validates classification on sample basis" (replaces manual Step 3).
Pain Points / Risks: - **Compliance risk**: Wrong HS code causes duty error and BOC penalty; mitigated by GRI-based classification and validation
System Touchpoints: - Item master HS code/duty; classification rationale repository

steps.activity: Trade Compliance assigns AHTN/HS code per SKU based on material, function, composition (General Rules of Interpretation); documents rationale
Master Data configures HS code and duty rate in item master; links to origin and FTA preference eligibility
Trade Compliance validates classification on sample basis; corrects mis-classification that over/under-pays duty

workflows.name: Tariff Commission Advance Ruling on Tariff Classification Application

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-generate of "Application for Advance Ruling on Tariff Classification" forms (replaces manual Step 1 assembly).
- System auto-submit of "submits to BOC" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-update of "updates HS code per ruling once issued" (replaces manual Step 3).
Pain Points / Risks: - **Compliance risk**: Self-classification on ambiguous items risks BOC challenge; mitigated by CRA for high-value items
System Touchpoints: - CRA application tracker; item master; ruling archive

steps.activity: Trade Compliance prepares the Application for Advance Ruling on Tariff Classification (TC Form 1, per TCC 001-17/CMTA Sec. 1100): product spec, sample, proposed classification, rationale
Trade Compliance Officer submits to BOC; responds to queries; tracks ruling issuance
Master Data updates HS code per ruling once issued; applies prospectively; archives ruling for audit defense

fields.Participants: Trade Compliance Manager, Treasury, Trade Compliance

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-validate of "validates exchange rate application" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-document of "documents alternative valuation if transaction value inapplicable" (replaces manual Step 3).
Pain Points / Risks: - **Compliance risk**: Under-valuation triggers BOC fraud case; mitigated by transaction-value method and documentation
System Touchpoints: - Import entry valuation engine; currency conversion; documentation archive

steps.activity: Trade Compliance computes transaction value per WTO Valuation Agreement: invoice price + freight + insurance (CIF) + dutiable additions
Treasury captures currency conversion at BOC-prescribed rate on date of filing; validates exchange rate application
Trade Compliance validates valuation method; documents alternative valuation if transaction value inapplicable

fields.Trigger: Import with assists, royalties, or selling commissions
fields.Volume: Subset of imports (private label, licensed brands)

workflows.name: Assists, Royalties & Additions to Customs Value Capture

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-document of "Trade Compliance computes additions to customs value" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-validate of "validates royalty/assist accounting" (replaces manual Step 3).
Pain Points / Risks: - **Compliance risk**: Omitted dutiable additions under-value goods; mitigated by identification checklist
System Touchpoints: - Import entry additions; transfer pricing alignment; documentation

steps.activity: Procurement identifies dutiable additions: assists (tools/molds provided free), royalties, license fees, selling commissions
Trade Compliance computes additions to customs value; includes in import entry; captures supporting documentation
Finance validates royalty/assist accounting; ensures intercompany additions align with transfer pricing (W235)

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-validate of "validates authenticity and accuracy" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-import of "Trade Compliance claims preferential duty rate at import entry" (replaces manual Step 3).
Pain Points / Risks: - **Compliance risk**: Invalid CO triggers retroactive duty + penalty; mitigated by validation and PSR documentation
System Touchpoints: - FTA preference master; CO validation; import entry preferential rate

steps.activity: Trade Compliance determines FTA preference eligibility per product-specific origin rules (CTC, RVC, or PSR) for AFTA/ATIGA/RCEP
Vendor provides Certificate of Origin (Form D for AFTA, RCEP CO, etc.); Trade Compliance validates authenticity and accuracy
Trade Compliance claims preferential duty rate at import entry; archives CO and supporting computation

workflows.name: Country of Origin Marking & Labeling Compliance

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-verify of "Made in [Country]" marking per DTI-BPS rules (replaces manual Step 1 checks).
- System auto-inspect of "inspects marking at goods receipt" (replaces manual Step 2).
Controls: - CTL-490 (ensure controlled execution — Tariff Classification, Origin & Valuation (PA-87.1).)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Compliance risk**: Non-compliant marking incurs BOC/DTI penalty and product seizure; mitigated by pre-import verification

steps.activity: Trade Compliance verifies "Made in [Country]" marking per DTI-BPS and BOC requirements on imported goods
Quality inspects marking at goods receipt; flags non-compliant marking for re-labeling or RTV
Merchandising ensures packaging/labeling meets consumer protection labeling (Filipino/English language, content disclosure)

workflows.name: Tariff Classification Master Maintenance & Item Master Integration

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-import of "import entry system" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-reconcile of "reconciles to active imports and BOC entries" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-490 (ensure controlled execution — Tariff Classification, Origin & Valuation (PA-87.1).)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Data-quality risk**: Stale master causes duty error; mitigated by versioning and quarterly audit
System Touchpoints: - Tariff classification master; import-entry integration; audit report

steps.activity: Master Data maintains tariff classification master: HS code, description, duty rate, FTA preference, origin
IT integrates tariff master with import entry system; ensures duty auto-computation; versions changes
Trade Compliance audits master integrity quarterly; reconciles to active imports and BOC entries

fields.Participants: Internal Audit, Trade Compliance, External Advisor

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-review of "reviews classification rationale vs." (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-file of "files voluntary disclosure with BOC where underpaid" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-validate of "validates classification of high-value/complex SKUs" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - operational: annual audit and voluntary disclosure
Pain Points / Risks: - **Compliance risk**: Undetected mis-classification accumulates liability; mitigated by annual audit and voluntary disclosure

steps.activity: Internal Audit samples imported SKUs; reviews classification rationale vs. GRI and BOC practice
Trade Compliance remediates mis-classifications; files voluntary disclosure with BOC where underpaid (mitigates penalty)
External Advisor validates classification of high-value/complex SKUs; provides opinion for audit defense
